en: All four sources were readable on the first pass today: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs Site Explorer and Site Audit, and Brand Radar. There was no repeat of the 20 Aug access outage. Every figure below was read directly today; nothing was carried over from yesterday.

GSC 28 DAYS (22 Jul -> 18 Aug): 63 clicks, 1,824 impressions, 3.5% CTR, average position 29.1, 150 queries with impressions. Impressions were SUMMED BY HAND across all 28 rows of the DAYS tab rather than taken from the rounded '1.82K' tile. Verification: the same 28 rows sum to exactly 63 clicks, matching the Total clicks tile.

Against 20 Aug: impressions 1,829 -> 1,824 (-5), clicks 65 -> 63 (-2), CTR 3.6% -> 3.5%, queries with impressions 151 -> 150. The one bright spot is average position 29.2 -> 29.1, the BEST reading recorded so far. Reminder: this is a rolling 28-day window, so movements are the window shifting rather than any single day's traffic.

Brand dependence remains very high: dxliving 34 clicks + dx living 18 clicks = 52 of 63 = 82.5% of all clicks. More striking: across the ENTIRE 150-row query table, EXACTLY TWO queries have a non-zero click count, and both are brand. The remaining 11 clicks sit in Google's anonymised-query bucket.

Every top non-brand query draws impressions but ZERO clicks: 'best home builders adelaide' 114 impressions at position 34.5; '3d renders for developers melbourne' 53 at 43.2; '3d renders for builders melbourne' 50 at 19.9; '3d rendering services melbourne' 49 at 35.9. The problem is RANK, not exposure.

GA4 28 DAYS (24 Jul -> 20 Aug): 133 sessions, 60 engaged, 45.11% engagement rate, 43s average engagement time, 4.56 events per session, 606 events, 1 key event. 63 users (49 new, 17 returning). Against 20 Aug: sessions 120 -> 133, events 569 -> 606, users 59 -> 63.

Engagement rate keeps sliding 50.0% -> 45.11% and key events 3 -> 1. The one remaining key event came from Direct. By channel: Direct 52 sessions, Organic Search 45, Organic Social 33, AI Assistant 3.

GA4 HEALTH CHECK - STILL GOOD. Two custom 7-day windows show the boundary cleanly: 7-13 Aug holds just 1 session while 14-20 Aug holds 92 sessions and 426 events. Homepage tracking is unchanged: 4 tag scripts actually load, google_tag_manager holds all three containers GTM-PZ9N8QTR / AW-18039433307 / G-43HE633LGK, the GA4 measurement ID G-43HE633LGK is present, and the #dx-analytics-dedupe script is still gone.

Even so the GA4 figures REMAIN an UNDER-COUNT, because the 24 Jul-20 Aug window still contains most of the 29 Jul-12 Aug outage. That data is permanently lost. The window should clear fully around 9 Sep 2026. Do NOT read 133 as a true 28-day traffic figure.
The AI assistant channel holds at 3 sessions from chatgpt.com (2.26% of total), 66.67% engagement, 15 seconds, 6.67 events per session, 20 events, still 0 key events - flat for a third day.

Ahrefs authority ticked up very slightly after yesterday's completely flat day: referring domains 425 -> 426 (+1, all-time 441 -> 442) and backlinks 440 -> 441 (+1, all-time 467 -> 468). Followed held at 8/8, i.e. 8 of 426 = 1.9%, for a sixth consecutive day. DR still 0, UR still 0, organic keywords and organic traffic still 0.

Ahrefs Site Audit: a fresh crawl ran today at 04:06 with Health Score 100, 15 URLs crawled (up from 14) and 0 internal URLs with errors. Note the caveat: Ahrefs only crawls 15 URLs, which is the shape of the broken sitemap, not the shape of the site. A Health Score of 100 here does NOT mean the site is healthy.

Crawled pages in Site Explorer moved 131 -> 135. The HTTP mix was read by applying each filter in turn: 127 at 200, 2 at 3XX, 5 at 404, 0 at other 4XX, 0 at 5XX. Those four buckets sum to 134 of 135; 1 page falls into none of them and is left UNEXPLAINED rather than being silently assigned. The 404 count holds at 5 for a fourth day.

AI CITATIONS HOLD AT 17. ChatGPT 11 and Copilot 6, both flat. The only movement: Copilot's cited-page count went 2 -> 3, so the per-platform totals are now ChatGPT 3 pages + Copilot 3 pages. The verified floor stays at 3. AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

SITEMAP.XML IS STILL BROKEN - DAY TWO, UNREPAIRED. The file is unchanged at 200 / 2,499 bytes / 16 URLs, still carrying the 'Free Online Sitemap Generator' marker, still containing NO article URLs at all, and still listing /login.

And the gap is WIDENING: the /articles hub links 63 distinct article slugs today, up from 59 yesterday. New articles are being published but are NOT being submitted to Google or to AI crawlers. Every day this sits unfixed is another day of new content going invisible.

The remaining technical signals all still PASS and some got faster: robots.txt unchanged (430 bytes, six AI bots with explicit Allow); /llms.txt 200 (12,695 bytes, 128 lines, unchanged since 18 Aug) with /llms-full.txt at 200; /faq 200 in 0.97s with FAQPage; /articles 200 in 1.12s (faster than yesterday's 1.74s) with CollectionPage + ItemList + Article + BreadcrumbList; /articles/3d-rendering-sydney 200 in 0.75s with Article + BlogPosting + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList; and the homepage carries exactly 2 JSON-LD blocks with Organization + LocalBusiness + WebSite.
TECHNICAL READINESS HOLDS AT 9 (6 of 7 signals). Only one signal is broken and it is still the sitemap.
AI VISIBILITY HOLDS AT 26. All five measurable dimensions are flat: Presence 2, Citation surface 1, Technical readiness 9, Third-party corpus 0, Measurement 1. Formula: (2+1+9+0+1)/5 x 10 = 26.

Accuracy, Sentiment and Position remain blank because Brand Radar prompt tracking is still off. The 'Dxliving' report still exists with 0 prompts and AI SoV '-' - unchanged for a third day. Nothing is guessed.
Third-party corpus holds at 0/10 and was NOT re-tested today - flagged as such rather than carried forward silently.

WHAT TO DO: (P0, now two days overdue) rebuild a complete sitemap.xml covering all 63 articles, drop /login and list /llms.txt; (P0) turn on Brand Radar prompt tracking with 15-20 AU prompts to unlock the three blank dimensions; (P1) attack rank for the non-brand cluster sitting at positions 19-44 with 49-114 impressions - '3d renders for builders melbourne' at position 19.9 is the closest to page two and the easiest win on the board.
